About this app

Complete Transport Solution for Citizen

NextGen mParivahan is a one-stop transport solution for citizens developed by the National Informatics Centre (NIC), Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Government of India. The app empowers citizens with instant access to various transport-related services such as Virtual RC, Virtual DL, RC & DL search, and much more directly from their mobile device.


Key Features:

• Virtual RC & Virtual DL

• RC / DL Search

• Citizen Sentinel

• Duplicate RC, Hypothecation Termination, Transfer of Ownership

• Change of Address, HP Endorsement

• Nearby transport services


This app is intended to bring transparency and citizen convenience to transport services across India.
